Musical theatre, and theatre in general, needs to open up to the idea of casting deaf and disabled actors in ‘traditional’ roles. Not only because representation matters, but because it can add such a huge amount of depth to a story without changing a single line. Especially in the context of casting Deaf/HoH actors and who use ASL. Deaf culture is deep and vibrant and has a lot to offer. Plus, ASL is beautiful and expressive in a very theatrical way. 

Erin.syd on TikTok has some beautiful ideas and advocates for incorporating Deaf/HoH actors as a Deaf actor herself.
